root.label: ATSB releases preliminary findings on Sydney Airport runway incidents

events.label: ATSB releases preliminary findings on Sydney Airport runway incidents

slots.name: ground conflict rate
slots.sentence: The incidents came as Sydney Airport recorded the highest rate of ground conflicts per aircraft movement among Australia's major airports in the post-COVID period, about 20% above the national average, according to a separate ATSB analysis.

slots.name: preliminary report date
slots.sentence: The Australian Transport Safety Bureau (ATSB) released preliminary reports Sept. 30.
